rec: Coins or more for carpet rides (400)
rewards: 10,000 Experience Lamp (Any combat skill except Prayer)

st.t: Talk to Father Reen outside Al Kharid bank.
Go to the Ruins of Uzer: take the magic carpet south of Al Kharid and choose Uzer, or use fairy ring DLQ and go north-east. Talk to Father Badden near the ruin entrance.
s: So what do you want me to do?

st.t: Pick up some black mushrooms beside the staircase into the ruins.
Use the black mushrooms on Silverlight.
Enter the Uzer ruins.
Pick up the strange implement in the north west corner of the ruin.
Talk to Evil Dave with the dyed Silverlight and 3 dark clothing items equipped.
s: I want to join your group.

st.t: Enter the portal next to Evil Dave, if he hasn't taken you through already. Talk to Denath next to the throne.
s: What do I have to do?

st.t: Talk to Jennifer.
s: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?

st.t: Talk to Matthew.
s: Do you know what happened to Josef?

st.t: Travel to any furnace with the sigil mould and silver bar and smelt a sigil.
Talk to the Golem in Uzer.
s: Did you see anything happen last night?

st.t: Search the kilns in Uzer until you find a book. There are four kilns; the last two are on the east side of the ruin and by the magic carpet.
Read the book.
Bring the book to Matthew in the Demon Throne Room. Afterwards Denath should start the ritual. If he doesn't, leave and re-enter the throne room and talk to Matthew again.
Go to the ritual circle in the throne room and stand in the empty gap in the ring of cultists, next to Denath.

Tap the demonic sigil and say the incantation in the order Denath told you, which is the reverse of the order in the Demonic tome. Write it down, as you need it again later. If you forgot it, talk to Denath and choose 'I forgot the incantation.' If nothing happens, unequip Silverlight.
Pick up the demonic sigil from the circle.
Leave the throne room.
Pick up the demonic sigil Tanya dropped.
Talk to Evil Dave.
s: You've got to get back to the throne room!

st.t: Talk to Father Badden in Uzer.
Talk to Father Reen in Uzer.
Talk to the Golem in Uzer. He will refuse to help.
s: I could just reprogram you again.

st.t: Use the strange implement on the Golem in Uzer.
Talk to the Golem again.
Talk to Matthew in the throne room.
Stand in the empty gap in the ritual circle again. This time it's two squares east and one square north of where you stood for the first ritual.
Tap the demonic sigil and say the incantation backwards from last time, which is the order written in the Demonic tome.
Kill Agrith-Naar. You can hurt him with any weapon, BUT YOU MUST DEAL THE FINAL BLOW WITH SILVERLIGHT.
Unequip Darklight to complete the quest!
